# The Panorama Markdown wrapping discussion did not establish a global rule

Review of D249930 prefers unwrapped Markdown for cleaner line diffs. The author defends the already wrapped local prose and character-level review tools; the landed and fixed document keep wrapping. Preserve this explicit difference in preference rather than infer a repository-wide prohibition or automatically change deliberate code grouping guidance. The same document describes account-manager startup and compatibility bridges, while its legacy-removal text remains a roadmap.

Scope: Scoped documentation style decisions.
